public_rationale: The available sources do not measure the stated total. Menlo estimates annual enterprise spending, while the OpenAI report discusses one company's forecast and revenue rate. Neither establishes cumulative worldwide generative-AI revenue through publication. The unspecified accounting basis also prevents a supported or contradicted verdict. The economic-share clause cannot settle the missing revenue total.
limitations: Enterprise estimates omit or differently classify consumer products and infrastructure.
The annual figures include a different period from the cumulative claim.
Menlo is an investor in the sector; its estimate is not audited sector accounts.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Generative AI's combined total revenue so far is only a few billion dollars, a tiny fraction of the economy.

statement.excerpt: Big tech wants the world to revolve around its new plaything, Generative AI (combined total revenue so far a few billion dollars, just a tiny tiny fraction of the economy), and to exempt it from any regulation.
statement.document_title: Give me compromise, or give me chaos

from_speaker: a tiny tiny fraction of the economy
our_interpretation: Assess cumulative realized revenue from generative-AI products and services through publication, across providers.
'A few billion' ordinarily means several billion dollars, not tens of billions; no exact cutoff is supplied.
Read dollars as US dollars and 'the economy' as the world economy.
The cumulative starting date is unspecified and remains null.
No accounting source or basis is identified, so accounting_basis is unknown and a supported or contradicted money verdict is unavailable.
Revenue is before expenses; treatment of reseller payments and other double counting is unspecified.
criteria.support_condition: A comprehensive, consistently defined cumulative revenue estimate through November 28, 2023 establishes several billion US dollars, with a clearly defined comparison showing a negligible share of economic activity.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable cumulative revenue evidence establishes an amount clearly outside the ordinary several-billion-dollar range, or a non-negligible economic share.
